free_text: The patient is a 63-year-old male with a PSA of 4.7 and a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right peripheral zone, classified as cT1c. Histology confirms ISUP grade group 1 disease. Given the severe LUTS (IPSS 35/35) and the need to weigh treatment benefits against risks, active surveillance with clinical review of treatment preferences is the current management assessment.
